become-a-resident.step.1.what: Ubala indawo ethile lapho uhlala khona.
become-a-resident.step.1.you: Funa indawo yegunya yakho yokuhlala bese uyikhetha.

become-a-resident.step.5.what: Ilungelo lakho lokuvota nokufuna isihlalo liyaqala kuyo yonke indawo yegunya owengxenye yayo.

become-a-resident.title: Ukuba umhlali
become-a-resident.your_part: wenza lokhu — ubhalisa, umemezela lapho uhlala khona, bese uvumela ukuba ukubamba kwakho kuqinisekise lokho

bill.step.0.what: Ilungu lendlu libhala bese lihambisa umthethosivivinywa ukuze isishayamthetho silucwaninge.

bill.step.1.what: Ikomiti efanele icwaninge umthethosivivinywa, izwe ubufakazi, bese ianquma ukuthi iwuphathele emhlanganweni yendlu yini.

bill.step.2.what: Umbhalo ophelele womthethosivivinywa ufundelwa wonke amalungu ngaphambi kokuvota.

bill.step.4.what: Umthethosivivinywa ufinyelele eningini elidingekayo futhi ubhalwe njengomthetho omusha.
bill.step.4.you: Buyekeza umthetho owenzekile njengoba ubonakala irekhodini lendlu.
bill.step.5.label: Kushicilelwe
bill.step.5.what: Umthetho wengezwa irekhodini lomphakathi futhi uba bonakale kuwo wonke umuntu.

budget.earn: isikhathi sokushaya umthetho sizokwamukela njengomuntu owazi imisebenzi

budget.step.0.what: Isishayamthetho sibuyekeza ingeniso elindelekile yendawo yegunya ngesikhathi esithile.

budget.step.4.label: Ibhuku lezimali
budget.step.4.what: Yonke imisebenzi ibhalwa ebhukwini lezimali lomphakathi futhi itholakala ukuze ihlolwe.
budget.step.4.you: Funda irekhodi lokucwaninga ekhasini leirekhodi lomphakathi.

committee-session.step.1.what: Amalungu abhalisa ukuba khona kwawo bese uhlelo luhlola ukuthi iningi elisebenzayo likhona.
committee-session.step.1.you: Bhalisa ukuba khona kwakho ukuze ukubalwa kwekhoramu kukufake.

committee-session.step.2.what: Usihlalo uxhumisa uhlu lwezinto ikomiti ezozibhekisisa.

committee-session.step.3.what: Abahlali nobufakazi abamenywe bakhuluma ngezinto zehlelo ngaphambi kokuba ikomiti ivote.

committee-session.step.6.label: Umbiko
committee-session.step.6.what: Usihlalo ufaka umbiko osemthethweni obhalisela izinqumo nezincomo zekomiti.
committee-session.step.6.you: Funda umbiko wekomiti lapho usihlalo sewufakile.

court-case.earn: ukuzwa kwenkantolo kuzokwamukela njengomuntu owazi indlela
court-case.step.0.label: Kufayilwe
court-case.step.0.what: Umhlali noma ummeli ufaka icala lombuso noma lezobugebengu enkantolo.
court-case.step.0.you: Faka icala lakho ekhasini leirekhodi lomphakathi.
court-case.step.1.label: Iphaneli
court-case.step.1.what: Inkantolo yamukela icala bese inika iphaneli yamajaji ukuba ilizwe.
court-case.step.1.you: Buka inkantolo ibhalisa ukuqashwa kwephaneli ekhasini lobulungiswa.
court-case.step.2.label: Izikhathi zokuzwa
court-case.step.2.what: Iphaneli ubamba izikhathi zokuzwa ezihleliwe lapho amaqembu nobufakazi bevela.
court-case.step.2.you: Landela icala irekhodi lomphakathi njengoba isikhathi ngasinye sokuzwa sibhaliswa.
court-case.step.3.label: Ubufakazi
court-case.step.3.what: Abammeli bahambisa ubufakazi bamaphepha nobufakazi bemlomo ephaneli.
court-case.step.4.label: Ijuri
court-case.step.4.what: Iphaneli ikhipha incwadi yokukhetha ijuri bese izakhamuzi zikhethwa.
court-case.step.4.you: Buka iphaneli ifaka incwadi yokukhetha ijuri ekhasini lobulungiswa.
court-case.step.5.label: Iziphakamiso
court-case.step.5.what: Omeli bafayila amabhriefu okuvala futhi bethule iziphakamiso zokugcina phambi kwephaneli.
court-case.step.5.you: Fayila ibhriefu yakho yokuvala ngokusebenzisa ikonsoli yummeli.
court-case.step.6.label: Ukucubungula
court-case.step.6.what: Iphaneli nejuri zicubungula ngokuyimfihlo ukuze zifinyelele esinqumweni.
court-case.step.6.you: Linda ukuba ukucubungula kuphele ngaphambi kokuhlola irekhodi.
court-case.step.7.label: Isinqumo
court-case.step.7.what: Iphaneli imemezela isinqumo sayo futhi, lapho kufanele, ikhipha iwuya wokugweba.
court-case.step.8.label: Umbono
court-case.step.8.what: Iphaneli ifayila umbono obhalwe phansi ochaza isizathu somthetho ngemuva kwesinqumo sayo.
court-case.step.8.you: Funda umbono oshicilelwe irekhodi lomphakathi lecala.

election.earn: ifóramu labakhethwa liyokwamukela njengomuntu owazi imithetho

election.step.0.what: Abahlali babona uhlu lwabo bonke abakhethwa futhi bakhombise labo ababavumayo.

election.step.1.what: Abakhethwa bethula izinhlelo zabo ukuze abahlali bafunde ngabo ngaphambi kokuvota ngokulandelana.
election.step.1.you: Funda ama-profile abakhethwa nezitatimende zomphakathi ngaphambi kokunquma ukulandelana kwakho.

election.step.2.what: Ibhodi lokukhetho livala isikhathi sokuvuma futhi liqinisekise ukuthi yimaphi amakhethwa aqhubekayo.
election.step.2.you: Buka uhlu lwabafinalisti luvela ekhasini lokukhetho.
election.step.3.label: Ukuvota ngokulandelana
election.step.3.what: Abahlali bahlela abafinalisti kusukela kulabo ababathanda kakhulu kuya kulabo ababathanda kancane.

election.step.4.label: Ukubala
election.step.4.what: Uhlelo lubala wonke amaphepha lokuvota ngokusebenzisa indlela yevoti elingusodwa elidlulisekayo.
election.step.4.you: Buka ukubala kwesigaba ngesigaba ekhasini lemiphumela.
election.step.5.label: Ukuhlala esihlalweni
election.step.5.what: Ibhodi lokukhetho liqinisekisa ukubala futhi abanqobile bahlala ngokusemthethweni ezihlalweni zabo.

election.step.6.label: Iseshini sokuqala
election.step.6.what: Ikamara elisha lihlangana okokuqala futhi ilungu ngalinye lithatha isifungo somsebenzi.
election.step.6.you: Buka ilungu ngalinye liyamukela isihlalo salo futhi lithatha isifungo.
election.title: Ukukhetho, kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni
election.your_part: uvota lokhu — vuma abakhethwa obathemba, bese ubahlela ngokulandelana lapho isikhathi sivuleka

stipend-and-tax.step.2.you: Sebenzisa ifomu lokudlulisa izimali ukuze uthumele ukukhokha ku-akhawunti kahulumeni.
stipend-and-tax.step.3.label: Irekhodi lomphakathi
stipend-and-tax.step.3.what: Yonke isithenshi nokukhishwa kwemali kukahulumeni kubhalwe futhi kuvulekile kunoma yimuphi umhlali ukuba afunde.
stipend-and-tax.step.3.you: Funda ikhasi lekhazeni ukuze ubone irekhodi lemali yomphakathi ephelele yendawo yegunya.
stipend-and-tax.title: Imali phakathi komuntu nohulumeni wakhe
stipend-and-tax.your_part: lokhu kuza kuwe — isibonelelo sifika ekhalandweni yakho, futhi ufilela uhlangothi lwentela wena uqobo
two-governments.earn: indlu yomphakathi yenhlolovo izokwamukela njengomuntu owaziyo imithetho
two-governments.step.0.label: Thola omunye
two-governments.step.0.what: Indawo yegunya ithola omunye uhulumeni kunetwork yomfelandawonye futhi ifunde incazelo yawo yomphakathi.
two-governments.step.0.you: Vula ikhasi lomfelandawonye ukuze ubone izindawo zegunya ezaziwayo nesimo sazo sokuxhumana.
two-governments.step.1.label: Thembana ngamarekhodi omunye nomunye
two-governments.step.1.what: Bobabili abahulumeni baqinisekisa futhi bamukele amarekhodi omunye nomunye aqondiswe ngobuchwepheshe njengawegunya.
two-governments.step.1.you: Buka ikhasi likesimo somfelandawonye njengoba ukuxhumana nomunye kuqinisekiswa kokubili ohlangothini.
two-governments.step.2.label: Izingxoxo zohwebo
two-governments.step.2.what: Abamele zombili izindawo zegunya baxoxa futhi basayine isivumelwano esisemthethweni somngcele.
two-governments.step.2.you: Buyekeza isivumelwano esihleliwe ekhasini lezivumelwano bese usayina lapho imigomo isilungiswe.
two-governments.step.3.label: Inyunyana noma umngcele
two-governments.step.3.what: Isishayamthetho sivota ukusungula inyunyana nendawo yegunya ehambisana nayo noma ukulungisa umngcele wabo ohlanganyelwe.
two-governments.step.3.you: Buka ukuvota kokusungulwa kwenyunyana ekamelweni lakho noma ufunde imiphumela yomngcele irekhodini lendawo yegunya.
two-governments.title: Ohulumeni ababili bahlangana, bahwebe, bese bahlangana
